stages.title: A camera, two 3D blobs, and a flat image plane
captions: The rectangle is where the camera image is formed.
We are looking at the whole setup from the outside.

stages.title: Follow the rays to the image plane
captions: Each ray meets the flat plane at an image position.
The nearby blue blob makes a larger mark.

stages.title: Look at the image plane from its edge
captions: Only our view of this diagram is turning.
The flat rectangle now looks like a line.

stages.title: Face the image plane again
captions: It is still a 2D image with width and height.
The 3D blobs have not turned into lines.

stages.title: Move the camera; leave the 3D blobs still
captions: Watch the camera image on the right change.
The same 3D blobs now project to different 2D marks.

camera: Pinhole camera; image plane is virtual, in front of the center of projection.
gaussians: Chosen illustrative covariances; first-order perspective projection, depth-sorted alpha blending.
source: Original teaching animation; no trained 3DGS result.
